title: Agent Notification Webhook Payload
description: Standard payload dispatched by SupremeAI services to external webhook consumers (Telegram, Discord, Slack channels, or any HTTPS receiver) for agent-system notifications (#51). Declared events: pr.opened, pr.merged, ci.failure, deployment.completed. Transport contract: HTTP POST with Content-Type application/json. The raw request body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 and carried in the X-SupremeAI-Signature header as 'sha256=<hex digest>' — the identical value format the Control Tower already enforces for inbound webhooks (infrastructure/mcp-control-plane/src/lib/webhook_signature.ts, #69). Receivers MUST verify the signature over the RAW received bytes (never a re-serialized JSON copy) using a constant-time comparison, and MUST fail-closed on a missing secret, a missing or malformed header (anything not starting with 'sha256='), or a digest mismatch. Severity maps to consumer presentation color: info (neutral), success (green), warning (orange), error (red). Reference verifier: examples/webhook-verification/verify.py (zero-dependency).

event.description: Notification event kind. v1 contract declares exactly four events; adding one is a schema version bump, not a silent extension.

service.description: Kebab-case identifier of the emitting SupremeAI service (e.g. supremeai-mcp-tower, supremeai-gateway). Enables consumers to route or filter by source.

severity.description: Presentation severity. Expected mapping for the declared events: pr.opened=info, pr.merged=success, ci.failure=error, deployment.completed=success.

message.description: Human-readable one-line summary suitable for direct rendering as a Telegram message text, Discord embed description, or Slack text block.

link.description: Absolute HTTPS deep-link to the triggering artifact (pull request, CI run, or deployment environment). Consumers render it as the notification's action link.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the notification was emitted (e.g. 2026-10-15T23:07:00Z).
